title: Draft Indian Standard STAINLESS STEEL COOKWARE SPECIFICATION Second Revision of IS 14756
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the minimum requirements for following types of stainless steel utensils: a) Cooking utensil; b) Serving utensils; c) Table utensils, and d) Storage utensils.
